svg.title: Certificado DNS, integración segura y Cloudflare
svg.desc: Sharp vector reconstruction of the 1211 by 278 pixel reference. The original three-part composition is preserved. Named editable layers contain a corrected certificate with one gold border, a symmetric embossed seal, two complete layered puzzle pieces, a complete orange key beneath a verification badge, a reconstructed Cloudflare cloud and editable wordmark, and a symmetric shield with a complete white key. Objects continue behind foreground objects rather than ending at visible occlusion boundaries. Dashed arrows use continuous paths and one uniform dash pattern. The canvas is transparent. Only cast shadows use alpha-only blur; every visible object and all text have sharp vector edges.

Certificado DNS, integración segura y Cloudflare

Layer order: ambient cloud and ground shadows; dashed connectors; DNS certificate; two puzzle pieces; orange key; verification badge; Cloudflare cloud symbol; Cloudflare text; shield and white key. Hide layer 06 to inspect the complete orange key, including its two teeth. Hide the shield layer to inspect the complete pale cloud behind it. Hide the main puzzle piece to inspect the complete rear piece, including its covered left edge and socket. No raster images, external resources, outlined text, or foreground blur are used. The Cloudflare symbol is a reconstruction from the supplied artwork.
